pages.title_zh: 手机 CPU 单核能效曲线
pages.title_en: Mobile CPU Single Core Power Efficiency Curve
pages.subtitle_zh: SPEC CPU 2026 使用 llvm 22.1.3 -O3 -flto -ljemalloc 编译。参测机型均为自购零售机。
pages.subtitle_en: SPEC CPU 2026 is compiled using LLVM 22.1.3 with the options -O3, -flto, and -ljemalloc. All units were self-purchased retail devices.

pages.title_zh: 手机 CPU 多核能效曲线
pages.title_en: Mobile CPU Multi Core Power Efficiency Curve
pages.subtitle_zh: 拆机使用假电池测量 Geekbench 多频点性能，去除屏幕功耗得到主板功耗。参测机型均为自购零售机。
pages.subtitle_en: Units disassembled and powered by a dummy battery for Geekbench multi-frequency testing; screen power excluded to isolate motherboard power draw. All units were self-purchased retail devices.

pages.title_zh: 手机 GPU 能效曲线
pages.subtitle_zh: 拆机使用假电池测量3D Mark SNL多频点性能，去除屏幕功耗得到主板功耗。参测机型均为自购零售机。
pages.subtitle_en: Units disassembled and powered by a dummy battery for 3DMark SNL multi-frequency testing; screen power excluded to isolate motherboard power draw. All units were self-purchased retail devices.

pages.subtitle_zh: 纵轴为充入能量，横轴为充电时间，均使用原装充电器，充电功率为官网标识值，计算电源端的输入能量，含电路损耗。
pages.subtitle_en: The vertical axis represents the energy charged, and the horizontal axis represents the charging time. All tests were conducted using the original chargers, with the charging power set to the values listed on the official website. The input energy at the power supply end was calculated, including circuit losses.

pages.subtitle_zh: 均使用自购零售机测试。点击机型或系统版本可观看全程录像。
pages.subtitle_en: All tests were conducted using retail devices purchased by us. Click on a device model or system version to watch the full video.

pages.subtitle_zh: *所有显卡均根据官方默认设定，未进行超频&降压。测试时已尽可能排除外界因素干扰。
pages.subtitle_en: *All graphics cards were tested using their official default settings, with no overclocking or underclocking. External factors were minimized as much as possible during testing.

pages.subtitle_zh: GPU峰值性能：苹果Metal，安卓OpenGL或Vulkan取最佳
pages.subtitle_en: GPU Peak Performance: Apple Metal, Android OpenGL, or Vulkan—whichever delivers the best results

pages.title_zh: 手机芯片综合性能排行
pages.subtitle_zh: CPU权重70% ,GPU权重30%。不包含功耗、AI、ISP基带性能。以骁龙865为基准
pages.subtitle_en: CPU weighting: 70%; GPU weighting: 30%. Excludes power consumption, AI, and ISP/baseband performance. Based on the Snapdragon 865.

pages.title_zh: 手机芯片 CPU 性能排行
手机芯片 GPU 性能排行
pages.subtitle_zh: 峰值性能权重50%，持续性能权重50%，结果受过热降频影响。以骁龙865为基准
pages.subtitle_en: Peak performance accounts for 50% of the weighting, and sustained performance accounts for 50%; the results are affected by thermal throttling. Based on the Snapdragon 865.

pages.title_zh: 手机芯片 CPU 能效排行
pages.subtitle_zh: 取3W-5W功耗段的多核性能计算能效。以骁龙865为基准
pages.subtitle_en: Calculate the energy efficiency of multi-core performance in the 3W–5W power consumption range, using the Snapdragon 865 as a benchmark.
